journey.name: spark connection details
journey.description:
Lightning Connections lists Spark last under OPEN CONNECTIONS, after any open channel, as "Spark via Breez" with a channel bar whose receiving side reads "no limit". Its detail screen shows the same bar, then STATUS ("Connection open" in green while Spark is connected, "Connecting..." in yellow, "Offline..." in red), PROVIDER (Spark operators, the regtest deposit address, the trust paragraph), BALANCE (receiving capacity "no limit", spending balance) and DEPOSITS, one group per deposit: its transaction (first and last 8 characters), the amount sent on-chain, which stays the same once claimed, and the claim fee once claimed or the confirmations until then. The footer holds "Transfer To Savings" and, while Spark holds funds or a force transfer runs, "Force Transfer To Savings". Spark's row shows once Spark is connected, so "Connecting..." and "Offline..." are covered by unit tests and the PR's screenshots, not here. On Spark's regtest the app's block explorer is the staging one, which does not know Spark's chain, so the deposit's page keeps waiting for the transaction; the journey checks only that the explorer opens at the deposit's txid.
Precondition: dev build on regtest with Spark connected on its regtest (journeys/README.md capabilities), no Lightning channel, and a claimed Spark deposit: send from Lightspark's regtest faucet (https://app.lightspark.com/regtest-faucet) to the deposit address the Spark connection screen shows (testTag "SparkDepositAddress") and wait for 3 confirmations. Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Tap the menu button (testTag "HeaderMenu"), Settings (testTag "DrawerSettings"), the Advanced tab (testTag "Tab-advanced") and Lightning Connections (testTag "Channels")
Verify the header's receiving reads "no limit" and OPEN CONNECTIONS lists "Spark via Breez" (testTag "SparkConnection") with its bar's receiving side reading "no limit", and no separate SPARK section
Tap "Spark via Breez" and verify the title "Spark via Breez" and the same bar at the top
Verify STATUS shows "Connection open" in green (testTag "SparkStatus")
Verify PROVIDER shows "Spark" with "Lightspark, Breez and Flashnet", the deposit address (testTag "SparkDepositAddress") and the paragraph starting "Your spending balance uses Spark"
Verify BALANCE shows "Receiving capacity" with "no limit" and "Spending balance" with the Spark balance
Verify DEPOSITS shows "Deposit tx" with the transaction id's first and last 8 characters (testTag "SparkDeposit"), "Deposit" with the amount sent from the faucet and "Claim fee"

Verify the footer shows "Transfer To Savings" (testTag "SparkTransferToSavings") enabled and "Force Transfer To Savings" (testTag "SparkEmergencyExit") with a warning icon inside the button, left of its text
Tap "Deposit tx" and verify the browser opens the block explorer at a URL ending in the deposit's txid
